location_description: San Jacinto ( SAN hə-SIN-toh, yə-SIN-toh; Spanish: [san xaˈsinto]; Spanish for "St. Hyacinth") is a city in Riverside County, California. It is located at the north end of the San Jacinto Valley, with Hemet to its south and Beaumont, California, to its north.
